nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public string token name 'FRANCE_WINS'.
Public string token symbol 'FRAWII'.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of spending allowances.
Constructor-like public function that assigns totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Transfer.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that debits the caller and credits the recipient without SafeMath.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) that overwrites the caller's allowance for spender.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) that moves balances and reduces the allowance without SafeMath.
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner key and spender key.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value unchecked subtraction risking integer underflow.
balanceOf[to] += value unchecked addition risking integer overflow.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value unchecked state write allowing arbitrary allowance overwrite.
balanceOf[from] -= value unchecked subtraction risking integer underflow.
balanceOf[to] += value unchecked addition risking integer overflow.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value unchecked subtraction of the caller's allowance.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, used as the recipient mapping key.
Parameter 'value' of transfer, amount moved between balances.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, key of the allowance mapping.
Parameter 'value' of approve, allowance amount written.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, source balance and allowance owner key.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, recipient balance key.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom, amount moved and allowance reduced.

edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender as the key receiving the initial totalSupply balance.
totalSupply is read in the constructor to seed the deployer balance.
balanceOf mapping is written in the constructor for msg.sender.
Constructor execution reads the totalSupply state variable.
msg.sender indexes balanceOf in the transfer deduction.
msg.sender is the owner key under which the allowance is written in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is decremented with -= and no SafeMath, risking underflow.
balanceOf[to] is incremented with += and no SafeMath, risking overflow.
balanceOf[from] is decremented with -= and no SafeMath, risking underflow.
balanceOf[to] is incremented with += and no SafeMath, risking overflow.
balanceOf state variable is accessed during constructor execution.
allowance mapping is written in approve for the given spender.
allowance entry is decremented with -= and no SafeMath before being checked only by require.
transfer parameter 'value' is subtracted from the caller balance without SafeMath.
transfer parameter 'value' is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath.
transfer parameter 'to' is used as the recipient key of the credit operation.
approve parameter 'spender' is used as the allowance key.
approve parameter 'value' is stored as the allowance amount.
transferFrom parameter 'from' keys the debited balance.
transferFrom parameter 'value' is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom parameter 'to' keys the credited balance.
transferFrom parameter 'value' is added to balanceOf[to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom parameter 'from' keys the allowance owner whose allowance is decremented.
transferFrom parameter 'value' is subtracted from the caller allowance without SafeMath.
transfer executes the sender balance deduction.
transfer executes the recipient balance credit.
approve executes the allowance overwrite.
transferFrom executes the source balance deduction.
transferFrom executes the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom executes the allowance reduction.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter is only used as the key of the balance credit unsafe operation.
The amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked balance deduction of transfer.
The spender parameter is only used to index the allowance write in approve.
The value parameter is only used as the allowance amount written in approve.
The from parameter is only used to key the debited balance in transferFrom.
The to parameter is only used to key the credited balance in transferFrom.
The value parameter is only used as the amount subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
